admitRate.sourceField: CDS C1: 61,533 admits divided by 69,617 applicants
admitRate.definition: First-time, first-year applicants admitted to ASU Campus Immersion divided by actionable applicants.

applicants.sourceField: CDS C1: total first-time, first-year applicants
applicants.definition: Actionable first-time, first-year applications reported by ASU Campus Immersion.

admits.sourceField: CDS C1: total first-time, first-year admits
admits.definition: First-time, first-year applicants admitted to ASU Campus Immersion.

enrollees.sourceField: CDS C1: total first-time, first-year enrollees
enrollees.definition: Admitted first-time, first-year students who enrolled at ASU Campus Immersion.

yieldRate.sourceField: Derived yield rate: 13,665 enrollees divided by 61,533 admits
yieldRate.definition: First-time, first-year enrollees divided by admitted applicants for ASU Campus Immersion.

undergraduateEnrollment.cohort: ASU Campus Immersion enrollment as of the Fall 2025 reporting date
undergraduateEnrollment.definition: All full-time and part-time undergraduate students reported by ASU Campus Immersion.

graduationRate.sourceField: CDS B4: six-year graduation rate for the Fall 2019 cohort
graduationRate.cohort: Fall 2019 first-time, full-time bachelor's degree-seeking cohort
graduationRate.definition: Share of the adjusted Fall 2019 cohort graduating within six years.

tuitionInState.sourceField: CDS G1: $12,527 in-state tuition + $1,007 required fees
